title: Józef Chełmoński, Storks, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Józef Chełmoński’s masterpieces in a unique collectible edition Perfect choice for lovers of realism and 19th-century Polish art Exquisite details reflecting the artist’s masterful craftsmanship Timeless beauty preserved in pure silver The masterpieces of Józef Chełmoński, filled with realism and natural beauty, have been immortalized in pure silver. This unique collection preserves the fleeting charm of the Polish countryside forever. Every detail reflects the artist’s mastery, blending art with collectible value. More than just a numismatic piece, it is a timeless heritage captured in an extraordinary form.
